subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class channel chat `/agent <id>` command that rebinds the current conversation to a configured agent, or keep channel-side switching limited to existing `/focus` and subagent/ACP session flows?
rationale: The request crosses agent session, workspace, auth, sandbox, and memory boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent user-facing command and policy model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a narrow guarded `/agent` command
options.body: Expose configured-agent switching only for bindable conversations, reuse the session-binding service, and gate targets through an explicit existing or newly approved allow policy.

options.title: Document `/focus` as the supported channel path
options.body: Keep arbitrary configured-agent switching out of channel chats and improve docs/examples around spawning or focusing bounded subagent and ACP sessions.

options.title: Defer to broader multi-agent UX design
options.body: Leave this open as part of a larger Control UI and channel-command design instead of adding another chat command now.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow guarded `/agent` command
recommendation.body: Expose configured-agent switching only for bindable conversations, reuse the session-binding service, and gate targets through an explicit existing or newly approved allow policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad work on command registry, session-binding docs, and generic conversation binding infrastructure, making this the best available routing owner for the product decision.
